items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Not that I know of. Not that I know of. He wasn't there.

ctx.x: He had his brother. His brother used to be a beat snare drum. Used to have a fellow beat bass drum. They called him Yance. Well, you wouldn't know the name. Their name wouldn't... What's his name? They used to call him Yance. That's the kind of Creole name. He got plenty of people around him.
Was he there before Clay Giles was playing bass drum?
Oh, that's a different band altogether. That's an extensive band.
